verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev is explicitly a code-first background jobs/workflow platform — tasks are 'plain async/await functions with no workflow DSL' and triggering/config is done via SDK code, not a visual editor. Community comments (e.g. comparing it unfavorably to n8n/Zapier's GUI, or explicitly choosing it because it avoids the code-vs-GUI split) confirm there is no drag-and-drop or visual workflow builder aimed at non-coding ops users.
